title: Learning to understand myself
body: Grateful to be gifted a membership. I enjoy keeping record and learning more about triggers and what helps.
author: Billyjo000

title: Bearable make changing meds bearable
body: This app has helped me so much transition medicine and I’m so greatful it exists
author: The viqueen

title: Great app to use
body: Overall I’ve enjoyed my time using the app. It sends reminders so you don’t forget to keep track of things as well as gives you data on if you have improved or not as per the week before. The only downside is some options are for subscription only. However this does not stop you being able to keep track of just about everything you need too. It also gives you the option to add your own symptoms and areas or feeling so you can really customise it to yourself
author: Emma_1991

title: Mood to Poop
body: This app is a bit invasive. It tracks your every move your every mood. It keeps a tally of whether you go to the bathroom and how that went. Gives you multiple opportunities every day to tell it how you are doing. You can choose what it tracks, depending on what you need to know about. All in all, I’m finding it pretty useful to help me put my finger exactly where it hurts.
author: EvaElisabeth
